subject: Coordinating prompt/output/log purge for Zephyr Health — schedule & verification
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@zephyrhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: legalops@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to purge prompts/outputs/logs for zephyr-prod workspace

Hi Tessa,

We need to initiate a full purge for our production workspace (zephyr-prod, workspace id zf-873). Scope: all prompt inputs, model outputs, and associated inference logs/KV cache entries going back to Jan 1 2025. This is part of a customer-driven data minimization request and internal compliance cleanup.

Can you share the typical timeline, what evidence you provide on completion, and any constraints (downtime, retention-imposed hold periods)? Wed like to schedule the sweep sometime next week (week of Oct 5). Legal is cc'd to confirm retention obligations.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Director, Platform Engineering
Zephyr Health

Attachments: None
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Samir Rao <samir@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, legalops@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request to purge prompts/outputs/logs for zephyr-prod workspace

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear scope.

High-level plan:
- Dry run & snapshot (no deletion) within 48 hours of sign-off to enumerate assets.
- Ops window: we can run the purge during your preferred 2-hour window; recommended off-peak (02:00-04:00 PT).
- Execution: purge of prompt inputs, model outputs, and inference logs/KV entries. We will not touch backups unless you explicitly request retention removal.
- Proof: we provide an erasure certificate (PDF), a sweep job log (text), and an S3/GCS object list showing deletions.

Proposed dates: dry run Oct 5, execution Oct 7 (PT). If that works, Ill create SUP ticket and attach our MOP (attached).

Ops contacts: Marissa Cole (Runbook/verification) and Dev Patel (Execution).

Deliverables attached: zephyr_purge_mop_v1.pdf (operational steps + rollback plan).

Thanks — Ill open SUP-2981 and loop Legal on the exact evidence format.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@zephyrhealth.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, legalops@zephyrhealth.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request to purge prompts/outputs/logs for zephyr-prod workspace

Samir — quick operational notes from the runbook:
- Well mark the target objects with a sweep tag and then run the expunge worker which clears model outputs, prompt text traces, KV cache entries, and audit-level inference logs.
- We produce both (a) a signed erasure certificate and (b) a hash-signed manifest of deleted object keys for you to verify. The manifest contains object keys and SHA256 digests (we do not include raw contents).
- Expected impact: <1% latency bump for live requests during the run; no downtime expected.

Legal: if you need retention holds or preserves, please flag them now; otherwise we will proceed with full deletion of the targeted objects on Oct 7.

Marissa
Director, Platform Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: operational checklist referenced in MOP
From: Legal Ops <legalops@zephyrhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request to purge prompts/outputs/logs for zephyr-prod workspace

Hi team,

We confirm Zephyr Health approves the purge schedule but ask Redwood to preserve platform audit logs (who/when API auth events) for 90 more days for internal regulatory purposes. The customer data itself (prompts/outputs) may be deleted as requested.

Please provide the erasure certificate and the manifest once available. Also confirm whether any snapshots or backups will remain after your sweep. If backups are retained, please list KMS key IDs and storage locations so we can assess further.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Senior Counsel, Zephyr Health — Legal Ops
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@zephyrhealth.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 02:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Execution complete: zephyr-prod purge (run-id: sweep-20261007-zf873)

Team — purge execution completed in the Oct 07 02:00 PT window. Summary:
- Sweep run-id: sweep-20261007-zf873
- Targets: prompt inputs (all), model outputs (all), inference logs & KV cache for workspace zf-873 (zephyr-prod).
- Backups: daily backups retained for 30 days per your account settings; long-term backups (archival vault) not included in this sweep. We did NOT touch cloud snapshot vault: vault-id arn:aws:s3:::redwood-archive-zephyr/zf-873 (no-delete flag). If you require archive removal, we will need a separate request.

Attached: zephyr_purge_certificate_20261007.pdf (signed erasure cert), sweep-job-log.txt (truncated), deletion_manifest_sha256.txt (hash of manifest).

Evidence links: SUP-2981 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-2981), drive folder with manifests (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1z-zeppelin-zephyr-purge).

If Legal needs KMS key IDs for the backups retained, tell us which keys to enumerate and well provide a table.

— Dev Patel
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
